Farhan Qureshi
QA Automation Engineer | Hyderabad, Telangana
farhan.qureshi323@example.com | +91 9433268317

Experienced QA Automation Engineer with a strong focus on building reliable, maintainable test suites and integrating automated tests into CI pipelines. Proven track record delivering measurable quality improvements across web and API platforms, reducing regression cycles and catching high-impact defects earlier. Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional teams to define test strategy and improve test coverage.

Experience

Vertex Analytics — Oct 2025 - Present
QA Automation Engineer | Remote
- Implemented end-to-end test suites using TestNG and Selenium for core web applications, reducing manual regression time by 65% and catching 30% more high-severity defects before release.
- Developed Cypress-based component and E2E tests for a new single-page application, improving front-end stability and decreasing post-release hotfixes by 40%.
- Created and executed automated API validation suites in Postman, adding environment-driven collections that cut API regression execution time by 50%.
- Integrated TestNG and Cypress runs into Jenkins pipelines with environment-parallelization, achieving 80% faster feedback for pull requests and maintaining build pass rate above 92%.

Trellis Systems — Jun 2025 - Sep 2025
QA Automation Engineer | On-site
- Led migration of legacy UI tests to Selenium with a modular framework, increasing test reusability and reducing flaky test rate by 45%.
- Built pytest-compatible adapters and TestNG wrappers to allow hybrid test execution, enabling simultaneous runs across multiple browsers and reducing test cycle from 10 hours to 4 hours.
- Created dashboarding for test results and failure triage using Jenkins test reports, cutting mean time to identify root cause failures by 30%.
- Collaborated with developers and product owners to define acceptance criteria and extend automated coverage for critical customer journeys.

Kite Learning — Oct 2022 - May 2025
SDET | Hybrid
- Owned test automation for core learning platform using Test Automation best practices, increasing automated coverage for critical flows to 78% and reducing manual regression efforts by 70%.
- Implemented Jenkins-driven CI pipelines to run nightly and PR-level suites, reducing regressions reaching staging by 55% and improving deployment confidence.
- Designed and executed performance-oriented test scenarios integrated with functional suites to detect regressions early, identifying and preventing two major release regressions.
- Maintained test documentation and runbooks in Confluence to standardize onboarding and troubleshooting, decreasing new-hire ramp time for QA tasks by 25%.

Projects
- Personal Regression Suite Optimizer — Developed scripts to parallelize and shard TestNG and pytest suites across containers on Linux, cutting full-suite wall-clock time by over 60% in CI.
- API Health Monitor — Built a Postman collection and Jenkins job to run hourly health checks for critical APIs, alerting on SLA breaches and enabling faster incident response.
